shifts.summary: The shift was reported as medium overall. Reasoning focused on diagram and figure based questions, with at least a dozen figures. General ability was described as easy compared with the previous year, featuring logical statements and some fixed‑answer knowledge. Quantitative section had time‑management pressure and several calculative items. English was noted as easy despite a long passage.

intro: The SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam held on 14 October 2026 has an unofficial medium difficulty rating for shift 1, based on most candidate reports. Reasoning questions focused on diagram and figure‑based items, with at least a dozen figures. General ability was described as easy compared with the previous year, while the quantitative section featured time‑management pressure and several calculative items. English was noted as easy despite a long passage. Figures are unofficial and SSC normalises scores across shifts.
